adaptation_notes: The connector Console/Keyboard change adds only its evdev keyboard source. No InputPlumber binary or dock Home/G-key support is added.

Speaker repair is rewritten in Python with exact OXP3 DMI, local ALC245 and empty-jack checks, current WirePlumber PID/time-scoped Speaker UCM evidence, profile revalidation, and visible command failures with attempted restoration.
Deployment uses new oxp3-speaker-* paths and independent ownership; upstream oxp3-audio-* paths are not overwritten.
The original public CPU baseline and HDR sources are untouched. No private performance research is imported.
Physical audio, headset, suspend and controller-dock acceptance remain required.
